schema_version: 1
name: ms-go-student
runtime_name: ms-student-service
service_kind: backend_service
repository_role: student_state_owner
repository:
  git_url: https://github.com/bemulima/ms-go-student.git
  default_branch: main
purpose: Own student onboarding, Course attempts, progression, objective evidence and mastery projections; retain legacy practice history read-only while ingesting v2 Practice competency evidence.
owned_capabilities:
  - computed authoritative NextActionResolver with one primary progression action, bounded runtime facts, machine reasons, and snapshot provenance
  - versioned onboarding profile and bounded learner overview
  - atomic Teacher onboarding-turn v2 commands with immutable receipt, accepted-value provenance, and no-effect recovery
  - multiple simultaneous Student-owned Course assignments
  - immutable placement-only official diagnostic attempts/results from Planner-fixed Course assessment plans
  - append-only diagnostic assessment attempt/item/receipt/submission/result aggregate with deterministic idempotent replay
  - multiple Student Learning Paths, one selected context/primary marker, item status, immutable path revisions, and diagnostic snapshots
  - Planner-only exact-path planning state, idempotent progress-safe replan, and exact-path NO_GAP completion
  - start and submit task attempts
  - final validation coordination and official answer status
  - automatic and manual review persistence
  - structured assessment scoring and answer-key-safe feedback
  - student course progression and access projections, including assigned private Courses
  - student position selections
  - read-only legacy student practice-task history and portfolio publication state; emergency writers are disabled by default
  - immutable sanitized practice-task portfolio publications and visibility
  - curated student learning evidence and idempotent integration inbox
  - distinct learning-action cycles and durable closure triggers
  - objective action-target evidence, policy-versioned mastery projection, and reducer audit
  - idempotent versioned Practice target evidence, shared mastery reduction, and Practice-specific audit
  - Student-owned learning sessions with optional Statistic correlation and bounded projected activity metrics
  - ownership-checked, bounded, secret-safe learning-action code context projection
not_owned:
  - Practice Runtime internal execution state machine or validation run orchestration
  - reusable courses, lessons, tasks, positions, and task definitions
  - reusable practice-task catalog, generation, v2 runtime, submissions, review, and results
  - sandbox workspace lifecycle and live validation
  - validator engine implementation
  - file blob storage
  - target/prerequisite graph, mastery gap policy, Course generation, or planning orchestration
entrypoints:
  executable: cmd/ms-student-service/main.go
  http_router: internal/transport/http/router.go
source_of_truth:
  behavior: [internal/domain, internal/usecase, internal/transport, internal/infrastructure]
  schema: db/migrations
  tests: [internal, test]
  documentation: docs/README.md
  contracts: [.ai/contracts/http.yaml, .ai/contracts/events.yaml, .ai/contracts/database.yaml, .ai/contracts/integrations.yaml]
required_at_startup: [PostgreSQL, NATS]
security:
  external_identity: trusted X-User-ID and X-User-Role headers
  jwt_verification: not_implemented
  internal_identity: X-Internal-Token shared secret
  teacher_onboarding_turn_identity: dedicated TEACHER_INTERNAL_TOKEN; empty disables routes and TEACHER_ONBOARDING_TURN_V2_ENABLED defaults false
  practice_learning_action_identity: required dedicated PRACTICE_TASK_INTERNAL_TOKEN protects Practice v2 reserve/read/open/cancel bindings and must differ from all other inbound internal tokens
  official_diagnostic_reservation: Planner-only reservation uses LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN and Idempotency-Key equal to plan ID; Course catalogue validation uses distinct COURSE_DIAGNOSTIC_CATALOG_TOKEN
  private_course_access: exact non-archived Student-owned assignment before trusted Course metadata is exposed
  default_internal_tokens: change-me
  portfolio_publication: mentor-approved artifact only; sanitized text snapshot encrypted before storage; no live sandbox or private evaluation data
delivery:
  commands: .ai/commands.yaml
  workflows: .ai/workflows
  policy_check: scripts/check-agent-policy.sh
